ops.body:
Branch dk-v021-migration, commit bf52839 (local only, not pushed), worktree /private/tmp/w5-cc-pool.

LANDED (option D mechanical subset)
- Pins: daemonkit v0.20.9 -> v0.21.3, synckit v0.35.2 -> v0.37.1. fusekit stays v1.15.5 in go.mod, overlaid from /private/tmp/w1-fusekit by an untracked go.work (gitignored) until v1.16.0 is tagged.
- Two-lane trust collapse: holder.RuntimeTrustRequirements{StopController,ReceiptController,ReadinessController,FileProviderExtension} -> holder.RuntimeTrust{Controller,FileProviderExtension}. holderbridge.RuntimeTrustRequirements() renamed RuntimeTrust(). trust.Requirement -> daemonkit.Requirement.
- holder.Config dropped StopControlStore, so holderbridge.RuntimeSpec.StopControlStore and the deployment.RuntimeStopControlStore() call in cmd/cc-pool-runtime-archive are gone; that command no longer imports any deleted package.
- Policy digest revved: daemonkit.PolicyDigest is a hex STRING, not [32]byte, and Requirement.Digest() replaces ValidationDigest(). runtimePolicyDigest 48e064e5... -> "cca1c08f02957912b419b602a6c4b943b8ef9d65906c7b5f3d38d29d2633b838", computed against daemonkit v0.21.3 for {TeamID SXKCTF23Q2, SigningIdentifier com.yasyf.cc-pool.status, RequiredAppGroup SXKCTF23Q2.ccp}. The App Group is unchanged so widget/Sources/FileProviderRuntime/Configuration.swift needed no edit.
- hostsync registry flock -> durable.AcquireLock (registryfile.go WithLock, converge_test.go). AcquireLock needs a ctx deadline, so each site derives one (30s / 1s) matching the old FileLockSpec.Deadline.
- CI: PR-only cancel-in-progress on ci.yml. Swift DaemonKit pin 0.20.9 -> 0.21.3. Both verify-suite-pins scripts green.

RESIDUAL: 83 files, 15 package dirs (was 91). dir | non-test | test | deleted packages used
  cmd/cc-pool                        1  1  peer,proc,trust,worker
  internal/accountterminal           1  1  proc
  internal/cli                       1  5  daemon,proc,service,trust,wire,worker
  internal/creds                     2  1  worker
  internal/daemon                    9 19  daemon,proc,service,trust,wire,worker
  internal/holderbridge              1  1  deployment,service,trust,trustroles
  internal/hostsync                  1  2  proc,worker
  internal/pool                      9  8  daemon,proc,trust,worker
  internal/procscan                  1  1  proc,trust,worker
  internal/statusapp                 3  2  codeidentity,daemon,deployment,proc,service,trustroles,wire
  internal/store                     4  2  proc
  internal/tenantfs                  1  3  proc,trust,wire
  internal/workerexec                1  0  worker
  scripts/sync-sim/seed              1  0  proc,worker
  scripts/vm/helpers/worker-deadline 1  0  proc,trust,worker

DELIBERATELY NOT DONE, with reasons
- trustroles at internal/statusapp/hooks.go:123,127 (+ hooks_test.go): the role values sit on service.StopRuntimeRequest and wire.RuntimeClientConfig/ClientConfig/UnixDialer. Removing them means rewriting the stop path onto v0.21 Client.Stop/Control, which is the frozen wire+stop-receipt residual.
- trustroles at internal/holderbridge/deployment_identity.go:249-251,307 (+ test): the three role fields plus deploymentQuiescePolicy.ControlRole are typed daemonkit trust.PeerRole, deleted with no v0.21 successor, and serialized into cc-pool's own deployment policy JSON that feeds the startup policy digest. Picking a replacement type is a design call, not a rename — and per the orchestrator (2026-08-03) the likelier outcome is that the question dissolves rather than resolves: cc-notes' lane settled the consumer-less deployment-policy golden as delete-per-captain-hook-precedent, so the design lane is expected to weigh DELETING cc-pool's deployment-policy JSON digest machinery outright instead of inventing a PeerRole successor. Do not design a successor type before that call lands.
- internal/store/store.go lifecycle lock: takes proc.FileLockShared. durable.AcquireLock is EXCLUSIVE-ONLY, so it is not a drop-in. Every open() (including OpenReadOnly) holds this shared lock for the store's lifetime, so making it exclusive would serialize concurrent store handles. Nothing in cc-pool takes the exclusive side. internal/store is red on proc.Record anyway. Carried into the design lane (orchestrator, 2026-08-03) as a REQUIREMENT rather than a casualty: reader concurrency across store handles must survive whatever replaces this lock.
- internal/pool/credential_locks.go and internal/daemon/syncwire_test.go locks: same files also use proc.Record/CurrentIdentity/ProcessGeneration/FileStore, i.e. the frozen ledger.

CAVEAT: none of the landed edits are compiler-verified, because every package containing them still fails on the frozen trio. The individual API shapes were each checked against real source (fusekit worktree holder/trust.go, holder/runtime.go, holder/plan.go; daemonkit requirement.go, durable/lock.go) and the digest was produced by a real compile against daemonkit v0.21.3. CHANGELOG deliberately untouched: nothing ships until the trio lands.
